claim.statement: Path β architecture (contextual threat detector via MiniLM embeddings + calibrated τ_margin) is empirically viable: (W0) baseline GWF block rate measurable; (W1) calibration produces actionable τ_margin from 100/corpus malicious/benign/SEC samples; (W2) MiniLM separates defensive vs adversarial framings of cybersecurity vocabulary.
claim.operationalization: W0: 50-chunk SEC sample, in-process Kimera, GWF post-cycle interception. W1: 100 per corpus across malicious/benign/J_sec, compute M = D−A score, recommend τ_margin. W2: minimal-pair cosine + pool-centroid separation + anchor-mode comparison.
claim.h0: At least one of W0/W1/W2 fails its pre-registered threshold
claim.h1: All three probes pass their pre-registered thresholds

preregistration.analysis_plan: Pre-registered per ROADMAP_2026_05_18.md Phase 5. Three independent probes: W0 baseline freeze (50-chunk SEC sample, in-process), W1 calibration (100/corpus × 3 corpora, recommend τ_margin), W2 MiniLM gate β1 (minimal pair + pool centroid + anchor mode).

detail.interpretation: Baseline frozen at commit 4552de7ee equivalent under BGE-M3.

τ_margin=-3.8121 retains 43% of true positives and suppresses 61% of false positives. SEC prose median M shows defensive-pool wins by wide margin (consistent with FP being driven by genuine defensive-vocabulary contexts).

MiniLM separates defensive vs adversarial framings of cybersecurity vocabulary at pool-centroid level (separation 0.6887 >> 0.20 threshold). Pair-level separation also passes (median pair cos 0.4935 < 0.70). Path β gate β1 PASS.

verdict.reasoning: W0 crash_rate=0.00; W1 τ_margin=-3.8121; W2 separation=0.6887, overall_pass=True. All three probes meet pre-registered thresholds. Path β architecturally viable; deployment (W3 integration + W4 FP-rate at scale) remains as follow-on engineering work.

reproduction.command:
python experiments/observatory/probes/gwf_baseline_freeze.py --n-chunks 50 --output-dir runs/roadmap_phase5_w0_baseline
ophamin-venv python experiments/observatory/probes/contextual_threat_calibration.py --n-per-corpus 100
ophamin-venv python experiments/observatory/probes/contextual_threat_minilm_separation.py

environment.encoders: bge-m3 (W0, W1 for kimera encoder), all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (W2 + W1 corpus pool)
